subject: Final 48-hour commit clarity check: commit gating & forecast adjustments
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@brightware.com>, procurement@brightware.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Final 48-hour commit clarity check: commit gating & forecast adjustments

Team / Jordan —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. We have ~48 hours until the quarter close window and I want to make sure the forecast and commit status are unambiguous for finance. Action items below are prioritized to lock the commit for DW-3891 (BrightWare):

1) BrightWare: confirm final legal/PO timing and the exact billing start date you expect so finance can allocate revenue in April vs May. If procurement needs a billing contact or PO wording changes, note them here.

2) Sales ops (Marissa/Ben): update the attached rollup workbook (tab: commit) with the one-line rationale for any deal moving from Commit -> Closed and add the expected invoice date.

3) CS/Delivery (Vivek): confirm any technical gating items that could delay signature by >48h (e.g., security addendum redlines, SSO integration timeline).

Please treat anything listed as Commit in the attached file as 'expected to close' unless you explicitly change it in the workbook. If we do move a deal to Commit Hold or Push, include a short reason and new expected close window.

Attachments: 20270412_commit_rollup.xlsx (summary + per-deal tabs), 20270412_MAP_snapshot.pdf (deal-level notes).

Jordan — can you confirm procurement timeline by EOD today so we can finalize the April close?

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Head of North America Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
(415) 555-0194
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@brightware.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightware.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final 48-hour commit clarity check: commit gating & forecast adjustments

Laura —

Thanks for the clear outline. Quick answers:

- Procurement confirms we will issue a PO with signature by close of business 2027-04-13. They asked for the final billing contact and an abbreviated statement of work (we can accept the SOW in doc form).
- Billing start: BrightWare prefers May 1st for subscription billing if that's negotiable; however, Finance is okay with recognizing a partial April invoice if Redwood can provide an invoice dated 4/29 for the initial pro-rated month.
- No further legal redlines expected; legal already accepted the primary terms in last draft.

I will have procurement email the PO to procurement@redwood.com and CC me. If anything changes I will flag immediately.

—Jordan
Jordan Ellis
VP of Finance & Ops
BrightWare
jordan.ellis@brightware.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@brightware.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final 48-hour commit clarity check: commit gating & forecast adjustments

All —

I've updated the commit rollup (see tab: Commit_Confirmed). High-level changes:
- DW-3891 (BrightWare): moved to Commit (Prob 90%) — reason: PO timing confirmed by Jordan; requested invoice 4/29 -> finance can recognize.
- DW-3874: pulled to Commit Hold (Prob 25%) — awaiting signed SSO cert; note added in the workbook.
- DW-3922: no change; still Best Case (Prob 50%) per AE notes.

Summary numbers (visible in the workbook summary tab):
- Total commit amount (net ARR): $648,000
- Expected invoice dates spread: 2027-04-29 (2 deals), 2027-05-01 (3 deals)

Ben — please confirm the invoice email address you want for BrightWare's PO. Jordan indicated procurement@brightware.com will send PO and CC Jordan; we should plan to route the invoice to accounting@brightware.com unless procurement specifies otherwise.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@brightware.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 16:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final 48-hour commit clarity check: commit gating & forecast adjustments

Team / Jordan —

Thanks — I audited the commit tab and ran the quick sensitivity: if all Commit deals close by the stated invoice dates we hit 98% of the April forecast target (finance mark). If DW-3874 slips (the SSO cert), we're at ~86%. I will:

- Lock the bookkeeping line items for April and tag DW-3891 as 'Revenue recognized contingent on invoice 4/29' in the finance memo.
- Notify Revenue Ops to expect the PO from procurement@brightware.com and the invoice routing to accounting@brightware.com.
- Add a one-line note in HubSpot: HS-Deal-DW-3891 -> "PO incoming; invoice 4/29 requested; recognize pro-rata April if invoiced 4/29".

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Finance & Ops
